close_reason: False alarm: the final check correctly handles initial_explicit_policy via the counter initialization at chain_walk start (explicit_policy = 0 if initial_explicit_policy=true).
description:
The §6.1.5(g) final check at lib.rs:2173-2175 correctly evaluates: 'if explicit_policy == 0 AND policy_tree is None → PolicyViolation'. This correctly implements RFC 5280 §6.1.5(g): 'path processing has succeeded if either (1) the explicit_policy variable is greater than 0 or (2) the valid_policy_tree is not NULL.'

However, re-reading the initialization at line 1528-1531: when `initial_explicit_policy = false`, explicit_policy is initialized to `n + 1` (where n = chain.len()). The decrement at line 1894 is only applied to non-self-issued intermediates. The decrement at line 1730 is applied to the non-self-issued leaf.

For a chain of length 2 (leaf + 1 intermediate), n=2, explicit_policy starts at 3. After processing the intermediate (non-self-issued): explicit_policy = 2. After processing the leaf (non-self-issued): explicit_policy = 1. Final check: explicit_policy (1) > 0, so success.

With initial_explicit_policy = true: explicit_policy = 0. After the leaf decrement: saturating_sub(1) = 0. Final check: explicit_policy == 0, check policy_tree.

This appears correct. But there's a subtle edge case: for a chain of length 1 (single cert, self-signed, acting as both chain and anchor), n=1. explicit_policy = 2. The loop processes i=0 (the cert). Since i==0, the leaf finalisation block runs. Is the cert self-issued? If yes, no decrement. explicit_policy stays 2. Final check: 2 > 0 → success. This is correct.

For initial_explicit_policy = true with a 1-cert self-signed chain: explicit_policy = 0. Leaf is self-issued, no decrement. Final check: 0 == 0. Check policy_tree: if the cert has a CertificatePolicies extension, the tree may have nodes. If no CP extension, tree is None → PolicyViolation. This matches RFC 5280 expectation.

**Resolution**: The final check IS correct. No bug found here. The edge cases all trace correctly. Document this analysis in the code with a comment at line 2171 explaining why checking explicit_policy after all decrements correctly implements §6.1.5(g).

Location: pkix-path/src/lib.rs:2171-2177

Filing as P4 (documentation clarification only).
title: §6.1.5(g): final check must also consult initial_explicit_policy
